blocks.text: Where people live: the old lanes, social housing and five capstone buildings. Numbers refer to the views below.

blocks.heading: WHERE PEOPLE LIVE
paras: Five capstone buildings on the former port land add 400 homes for 1,220 people. Road widening displaces 1,000 residents, and all of them are rehoused in social housing on the same lot, with 250 more places. In all, 10,500 people live here, up from 9,230.

blocks.heading: WHO LIVES HERE
paras: Land for homes grows from 2.53 ha to 4.24 ha, so homes get more room: people per hectare of housing fall by a third, from 3,648 to 2,476. Each capstone building has 80 homes, from one to three bedrooms, for 244 people.
